svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content: Level 2 Use Case: Subsystem 2.0 (Inventory & Stock Management)

g.text: UML Use Case Diagram: Level 2 – Subsystem 2.0 (Inventory & Multi-Location Stock Management)
Primitive Functional Decomposition aligned with DFD Level 2 (2.1 to 2.6) and WBS Level 3
Master Categories, Units of Measure & Storage Specifications
Parent Facilities, Storage Zones & Capacity Limits
Process 2.2: Reconcile Stock Quantities via Transactions
Inbound Receipts, Outbound Sales & Automated Linked Financial Postings
Process 2.4: Track Stock Movement & Batch Lot Histories
Lot Barcodes, Expiration Lifecycles & Audit Trails
Worker Deletion Requests, Manager MFA Authorization & Archive Logs
Transfer Orders, Transit Chain-of-Custody & Destination Reconciliation
General Ledger Destination for Linked Financial Records
